_note: Draft labels for a daytime VFR flight in a single-engine piston, 23 Sep 2026 0700-1600Z, below FL065. Every candidate not listed under a route is labelled NOT relevant with the default reason for its group. Verify before using as ground truth.

_default_reasons.IFR: IFR procedure or approach minima; no effect on a VFR flight
_default_reasons.EDXX: Germany-wide security or airspace-policy notice about distant FIRs or airline ops
_default_reasons.EHAM: Schiphol ground ops, cranes or IFR minima; the coastal VFR route stays outside the Schiphol CTR
_default_reasons.FAR: Circle only touches the corridor; the item is far from the actual track or concerns another aerodrome or a region the route does not cross
_default_reasons.LIGHTS: Obstacle lighting unserviceable; daytime flight and the obstacle is well clear of the track

A2061/26.r: Bird hazard at departure during the flight window
